source.title: WCT Leader Announcement (January 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Rui Reis will become the new Leader of the WCA Communication Team (WCT). Rui was already working as a Senior Member of the WCT.
<!-- break -->
Rui was selected by the WCA Board, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Lauren Clement for the work she has done for the WCT as the Leader, and wish Rui the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

* Chandler Scheurkogel

We thank Chandler for applying and both applications can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1Ep0-pai7bgb2BCTmTUfh_-OAtcIgcaI1).

translation.title: WCA 通讯组负责人任命公告（2022 年 1 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Rui Reis 将担任 WCA 通讯组（WCT）的新任负责人。Rui 此前已在 WCT 担任高级成员。

WCA 董事会依照委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节选定 Rui。

感谢 Lauren Clement 在担任负责人期间为 WCT 所做的工作，也祝 Rui 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

董事会还收到了以下申请人的材料：

* Chandler Scheurkogel

感谢 Chandler 提交申请。两人的申请材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1Ep0-pai7bgb2BCTmTUfh_-OAtcIgcaI1)查看。
